Braces in Dublin CA
Braces in Dublin CA | Dr Dante Gonzales Orthodontics for Adults & Teens

When people hear braces in Dublin, most imagine teenagers with shiny wires. But at Dr. Dante Gonzales Orthodontics, we see patients of every age — we treat from age 7 to 70 because it’s never too late to have straight teeth and a good bite. Our orthodontist focuses on making every treatment plan fit real life, not just an X-ray. Every smile tells a different story.

We’ve seen misaligned teeth, jaw imbalances, open bites, and even cases where tooth loss changed how a person chews. With orthodontic treatment, the idea is not only to make things straight but also to improve oral health and how your teeth fit together naturally. Sometimes it feels like small changes, but it changes how you smile and eat every day.
Why Choose Braces in Dublin at Dr Dante Gonzales Orthodontics

Our Dublin office makes braces treatment easy to start and easier to continue. The whole process feels smoother because every patient gets a personalized treatment plan. We begin with digital X-rays, impressions, and a conversation. It’s not rushed. We ask about your habits, your daily routine, even your snacks. Because that’s how we decide what kind of braces options suit you best.

Whether it’s metal braces or clear ceramic braces, the focus stays on balance, good alignment, comfort, and a result that lasts. For some, we use fixed braces; for others, clear aligners do the job just as well. The key is the right assessment. That’s how we see it anyway.

What are Traditional Braces and How They Work?

Traditional braces use small brackets bonded to your teeth with a special adhesive. Wires and elastic bands apply gentle pressure to move each tooth into its desired position. Over time, your bite improves, and your smile begins to line up perfectly. Feels slow at first, but it’s steady progress.

We use both traditional metal braces and more discreet options like clear ceramic braces. Metal braces remain the strongest and most reliable choice, especially for teens and adults with more complex orthodontic needs. The strength of metal allows precise tooth movement even in deep or challenging cases.
It’s simple really, braces fix what’s not aligned. But how we get there depends on your teeth, your mouth, and your smile goals.

Adult Braces in Dublin – Confidence at Any Age

Some think braces are just for kids. Not anymore. Adult braces are more common than ever at our Dublin office. We treat working professionals, parents, and older adults who finally decided to straighten their teeth. Sometimes after years of avoiding photos.

With today’s options like ceramic braces or clear aligners, treatment fits into daily life comfortably. We design every treatment plan around your schedule, shorter visits, fewer adjustments, and easier cleaning. Our orthodontist checks every few weeks to monitor progress and make small adjustments as your teeth move into new positions.

Adult braces help correct long-standing orthodontic issues, from misaligned teeth and crowding to open bite or overbite. Once treatment finishes, patients often say it feels lighter to smile. That’s worth every visit.
Start Your Adult Braces Journey
The Braces Treatment Process Step by Step
Free Consultation – We start with a full mouth check, photos, and X-rays. You’ll meet our orthodontist and discuss what’s possible.
Customized Treatment Plan – Based on your teeth and bite, we suggest the right option, metal braces, ceramic braces, or clear aligners.
Braces Placement – The brackets are fixed using a special adhesive, wires are fitted, and the journey begins.
Regular Appointments – Every 6–8 weeks, we monitor progress, make adjustments, and ensure your oral hygiene stays strong.
Retention and Follow-Up – After braces treatment, retainers keep your teeth in their desired position.
The whole process feels manageable once you see results. The first few weeks take getting used to, but after that, it becomes part of your day. Sometimes, even brushing feels like meditation.
The Importance of Good Oral Hygiene
Wearing braces means you must maintain good oral hygiene daily. Food particles often get stuck near brackets, wires, and elastic bands. If not cleaned, they cause plaque and affect oral health.

We teach patients to brush 3–4 times per day, use floss threaders to floss once daily, and rinse regularly. For adults, especially those using metal braces, keeping the mouth clean prevents gum swelling. And for teens, it’s a chance to build habits early. Maintain good oral hygiene, and the final smile looks even brighter.

blocks.text: How Braces Fix Misaligned Teeth

Braces fix misaligned teeth by applying gentle pressure over time. This moves your teeth into the desired position, allowing your bite and jaw to align properly. It’s not just cosmetic. Correcting your bite improves chewing, speech, and overall oral health.

We sometimes see front teeth pushed forward or lower teeth crowding. Small metal adjustments with elastic bands can solve that easily. For adults, fixed braces work especially well since they need steady, consistent movement. Every adjustment brings teeth closer to their perfect alignment. The patience pays off.
Types of Braces Options We Offer
Each patient’s orthodontic treatment is unique. Some prefer quick results, others want comfort or invisibility. At our Dublin office, we offer:
Traditional Braces: Reliable and durable; effective for all ages.
Metal Braces: Strong and precise; best for complex movements.
Ceramic Braces: Less visible, suitable for professionals.
Clear Aligners: Comfortable and removable; perfect for minor corrections.
Every choice starts with a free consultation where our orthodontist discusses your needs, cost, and expected timeline. That first chat makes things clearer.

Creating a Dream Smile with Expert Orthodontic Care

Our job isn’t only to straighten teeth. It’s to help you reach your dream smile with safe, evidence-based orthodontic care. From braces to clear aligners, everything happens in one office. We plan each treatment slowly, carefully, making sure you’re comfortable during every step.

Some patients come in expecting discomfort, but leave surprised at how light it feels. The gentle pressure of metal braces is steady, not harsh. You can still eat most foods, talk easily, and live normally. Sometimes even forget they’re there.
Keeping Gums and Teeth Clean During Braces
Braces collect food particles easily. That’s why keeping teeth clean is part of the daily routine. Brushing twice, using floss threaders, and avoiding sticky food keeps your gums healthy.

Our orthodontist often reminds patients that clean teeth move faster. When oral hygiene stays consistent, the treatment time shortens. Neglecting it can cause white marks or even tooth loss later. So we always say, take those five minutes every night. It really matters.
How We Monitor Progress During Treatment

At every regular appointment, we check how the teeth and jaw are responding. The orthodontist adjusts wires or elastic bands if needed. We also take small progress photos, so you see changes yourself. It’s motivating when that first visible gap closes.
Our team makes sure every treatment plan stays on schedule. Whether it’s metal braces or clear aligners, keeping track of your progress keeps results predictable and smooth.
Teeth Straightening for Children, Teens, and Adults

We treat patients of all ages. For children, early orthodontic treatment prevents crowding before permanent teeth erupt. Teens benefit from faster bone response, and adults value confidence and improved oral health. It’s never too late to start.

Even adult braces with metal brackets or ceramic braces can make a huge change. Many adults complete treatment in 12–24 months, depending on their orthodontic issues. The feeling after seeing that straight reflection is beyond words.
Maintaining Oral Health After Braces

Once braces come off, teeth feel new, smooth, and sometimes strange at first. But keeping oral hygiene intact remains essential. We provide retainers and check-ups to ensure teeth stay in their desired position.
Avoid skipping follow-ups. Small shifts can happen if retainers aren’t worn. It’s like maintaining a new car, you protect what you worked for. Feels like common sense, but still worth saying.
Payment Plans and Free Consultation

Many people delay orthodontic treatment thinking it’s too expensive. Our Dublin office offers affordable payment plans and accepts most insurance providers. We also give every patient a free consultation today before starting any treatment required.

Every patient walking out after finishing braces treatment leaves with a lighter face. Their posture even changes. You can see the difference in their photos. A radiant smile, clean teeth, and renewed confidence, that’s what this journey is about.
We believe a confident smile comes from steady care, regular visits, and good teamwork between you and our orthodontist. Feels more human that way.

Why Our Patients Recommend Us

We’ve seen many patients bring their friends or family after finishing treatment. They say the atmosphere feels welcoming. The staff remembers names, stories, even favourite snacks. That warmth can’t be measured.
From adults with demanding jobs to teens juggling school, everyone finds the rhythm with our Dublin orthodontist. That’s what makes results stick. You enjoy coming, so you finish strong.
Get Your Dream Smile with Braces in Dublin CA

When you look at your reflection after braces, you’ll see more than straight teeth. You’ll see confidence, balance, maybe even a touch of relief. Every adjustment, every regular appointment, every moment of care leads to that single perfect smile.
And when your friends notice, you’ll know it was worth it. It’s not just about looks, it’s about comfort, function, and freedom to smile fully.
That’s what we believe here at Dr Dante Gonzales Orthodontics. The science and skill matter, but so does patience and care. Feels like real work sometimes, but that’s how real results come.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. How long does braces treatment usually take in Dublin CA? It depends on your case, but most patients complete braces in 12 to 24 months. Regular check-ups help keep treatment on schedule. 2. Are ceramic braces as effective as metal braces? Yes, they work just like metal braces but look more natural. Many adults choose ceramic braces for a subtle appearance. 3. Can I get a free consultation before starting braces? Yes. Dr Dante Gonzales Orthodontics offers a free consultation in Dublin CA to review your teeth and suggest the best treatment plan for you 4. Do braces hurt after getting them? You might feel mild pressure or soreness for the first few days as your teeth begin to move. It’s a normal part of the process and usually fades quickly. Most patients say it feels more like tightness than pain, and over-the-counter relief works just fine. 5. Can adults get braces even if they’ve had dental work before? Absolutely. Many of our adult patients have fillings, crowns, or even implants. We design your orthodontic plan around your existing dental work to ensure everything aligns safely and comfortably. It’s never too late to improve your smile.
